Package io.micronaut.data.jdql

Class JDQLBaseListener

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.jdql.JDQLBaseListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
JDQLListener, org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeListener
public class JDQLBaseListener extends Object implements JDQLListener
This class provides an empty implementation of JDQLListener, which can be extended to create a listener which only needs to handle a subset of the available methods.
